explication: MaxText is a JAX-based, TPU/GPU-scalable LLM platform. The principal workflow is: a user configures pre-training or post-training, datasets are tokenized and sharded, a model executes distributed pipeline steps through the training engine, and checkpoints are persisted. The same model stack supports offline and served generation, evaluation, multimodal inputs, and checkpoint conversion. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime paths and README-described capabilities; several unsampled trainer integrations are represented only at their documented directory boundaries.
